findings.title: include_website_name is missing the trailing `?`
findings.body: ActiveModel::Serializers looks for a predicate named `include_website_name?`. The method defined here is `include_website_name` (no question mark), so it is never called and `website_name` is unconditionally serialized — including when `website` is blank (serialized as `null`). Rename to `include_website_name?`.

findings.title: website_name is not in untrusted_attributes, leaking website for TL0 users to anonymous
findings.body: `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes` so it is hidden when `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` (TL0 user seen by anonymous). The new `website_name` attribute is not in that list, so the host (and possibly full path) of a TL0 user's website is still exposed to anonymous visitors, defeating the spam-protection intent. Add `:website_name` to `untrusted_attributes`.

findings.title: No test that website_name is hidden for untrusted users
findings.body: The TL0/anonymous context asserts only the previously-listed untrusted attributes. Since `website_name` now derives from `website`, a spec asserting `json` has no `website_name` key for a restricted user is needed to lock in the privacy behaviour.

findings.title: String literal mutation with `<<` in ends_with? comparison
findings.body: `discourse_host.ends_with?("." << website_host)` uses destructive append on a string literal. It works today, but under frozen string literals (`# frozen_string_literal: true` or Ruby 3.x with the magic comment/`--enable-frozen-string-literal`) this raises FrozenError. Use `".#{website_host}"` instead.

findings.title: URI parsed up to three times per call; website without scheme yields no name
findings.body: `URI(website.to_s)` is re-evaluated in each branch (wasteful, and the second/third calls are not inside the rescue, so a malformed URI that raised once could raise unrescued later). Also, for a website stored without a scheme (e.g. `example.com/user`), `URI#host` is nil and the method returns nil, so no website is shown at all even though `website` is present. Parse once into a local and handle the scheme-less case.
